messages:
jen_support: FYI - customer 'AcmeCorp' hit a hard 400 from the function-calling API. Says it started after they updated their client lib. Getting schema validation errors + a billing spike. Can someone take?

sam_engineer: Thanks Jen. Can you paste the request body + response? Also which model + function they were invoking?

jen_support: Pasting minimal repro (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/functions/call \  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX' \  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  -d '{"model":"rwd-2.1","function":"charge_customer","args":{ "customer": {"acct_id":"ACME-123","email":"ops@acme.com"}, "amount":"100.00", "currency":"USD", "session_id":"s-7e3", "timeout":"30s"}}'
```

jen_support: Response body: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": 400,
    "message": "Function call validation failed",
    "details": [
      {"path":"$.args.customer.acct_id","message":"expected integer but got string"},
      {"path":"$.args.amount","message":"expected number but got string"},
      {"path":"$.args.timeout","message":"expected integer (seconds) but got string '30s'"},
      {"path":"$.args","message":"additionalProperties not allowed: \"session_id\""},
      {"path":"$.meta","message":"required property 'user_id' missing"} 
    ]
  }
}
```

sam_engineer: Looks like three separate schema issues: type mismatches, an unexpected extra property (session_id), and a missing required meta.user_id. Also saw the billing spike in their account at the same time?

ops_billing: I see a sudden 3x token usage bump from AcmeCorp starting ~1918765400. Likely retries from the client. Billing system flagged multiple failed attempts counted as usage due to streaming tokens being consumed before the validation error returns.

maria_oncall: @sam_engineer @eva_prod we should triage: customer is blocked in production. Prioritize a short-term mitigation (accept extra properties / tolerate string numbers) and a long-term fix (clearer SDK validation + better error codes). Thoughts?

eva_prod: Agreed. Short-term we can relax strict additionalProperties check for charge_customer function and coerce numeric strings if they match numeric pattern. But need to be careful—this affects contract guarantees. Propose: canary the schema relaxation on Dedicated region us-west-2 for 1% of traffic. If safe for 2 hours, roll to hosted.

sam_engineer: Implementation plan: 1) update function schema in schema-registry: set additionalProperties=true for that function; add a transformer to coerce amount and timeout when they match regex. 2) Patch runtime validator to emit a distinct warning code (422-warn) so clients see it's been coerced. 3) Add infra rule to not count tokens consumed by retries as billable until validation finalizes.

jen_support: Customer asked for repro steps they can run. I'll give them a test endpoint if you want. Also they want a rollback plan.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2834 by maria_oncall. Priority: P2 (customer-blocking). Links: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-2834

maria_oncall: @sam_engineer please add exact repro harness (curl + minimal node/python snippet) to the incident so SRE can rate-limit retries if needed. Also loop in legal if billing credit will be needed.

sam_engineer: Adding repro and quick patch to the incident now. Repro snippet (node):
```js
const payload = {
  model: 'rwd-2.1',
  function: 'charge_customer',
  args: {
    customer: { acct_id: 'ACME-123', email: 'ops@acme.com' },
    amount: '100.00', // string that should be number
    currency: 'USD',
    session_id: 's-7e3', // extra prop
    timeout: '30s' // string that should be seconds int
  },
  meta: {} // missing user_id
};
// sdk.callFunction(payload) -> expect 400 validation error
```

eva_prod: For the canary: create a feature flag in rollout-service 'relax-schema-charge-customer' and route 1% via traffic splitter to a validation shim which has the looser rules. Enable detailed logs for 30 min, then evaluate. If OK, progressive rollout.

ops_billing: For billing: will open a customer credit case and freeze billing for the failed attempts window (1918765380-1918765480) pending root cause. Please add links to audit logs so we can reconcile tokens counted.

jen_support: Customer responded: "we just updated from sdk v1.3.2 -> v1.4.0 which now serializes acct_id as string. We assumed backward compat. We need a patch or a config flag asap."

sam_engineer: Ok. I'll cut a hotfix PR to schema-registry and push the shim behind the rollout flag. If we can get canary up in 40m I can ask ops to unfreeze customer traffic to confirm.

eva_prod: Also add a short-term client-side suggestion in the SDK release notes: validate types before sending and avoid retries on 4xx. Long-term we'll make SDK throw early validation errors.

maria_oncall: Marking this thread as primary comms until resolved. Keep updates concise.

jen_support: Will update customer with canary ETA ~45m and create a billing ticket link. Thanks all.
